description: bcgroundwater is an R package for analysis and visualisation of British Columbia's Provincial Groundwater Observation Well Network. Users can obtain or load well measurements, choose stations and periods, and create time-series summaries for water-resource study. Geographic coverage is the British Columbia monitoring network, with local gaps where no well reports data. The provider README describes the source network and package functions, and GitHub metadata states Apache-2.0 licensing. A limitation is that groundwater level is measured at a particular depth and aquifer setting; it does not directly express sustainable pumping yield or water quality. Station metadata and gaps require inspection before calibration. The package can help test drought or supply scenarios for water infrastructure. The related catalogue ERA5 reanalysis provides precipitation and temperature context but not aquifer observations. No well measurements or package were downloaded.
name: bcgroundwater observation analysis package
